title: An `acceptedAt` whose fields are each legal and whose date does not exist
why: Its sibling `schema-invalid-accepted-at-impossible-date` puts every field out of range at once, so an engine that merely bounds each field passes it — and then accepts `2026-02-30`, which is the shape a real off-by-one produces. Every field here is individually legal; only the calendar rejects it, which is why the check is a round trip through the date rather than four range tests.
